summary: Stronger sign-in protection, simpler and safer access for ticketing systems, faster changes after Commit, and for Pro a chat in the Manager.

new.title: Chat in the Manager (Pro)
new.text: Ask in plain words and have changes prepared, answered by your own Azure OpenAI deployment without any key, under your own role. Changes are only prepared; you save them. Off by default.

fixes.title: Sign-in checked by Microsoft's own code
fixes.text: Every sign-in is checked with Microsoft's own sign-in checks, and PIM Manager makes sure they work each time it starts, before anyone can use it.

fixes.title: Your sign-in stays fresh
fixes.text: The page renews your sign-in before it ends, and offers Sign in again or Sign in with another account when needed.

fixes.title: No shared keys for ticketing systems
fixes.text: Ticketing systems that switch admin accounts on for a time now sign in with their own Microsoft Entra identity. Shared keys are gone, and the systems you already approved keep working without a change.

fixes.title: Commit and Run now within a minute
fixes.text: After Commit or Run now, your change is applied within about a minute, and the Manager itself still cannot start or change the engine.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The Manager no longer needs access to the key store, the emergency passphrase is checked safely inside your own database, and discovery mails are marked as information, not warnings.
